name: Open-Medical-Affairs Data-Sources manifest
synthetic_label: SYNTHETIC — fictional data for training/workshops, not real patients/products
public_warning: REAL PUBLIC SOURCES, NOT SYNTHETIC. Check each source's terms before copying or redistributing data. Never send PHI or confidential company data in a query. Retrieval does not verify a scientific claim.

access_legend.download: Hosted in this repository. direct_url downloads the file.
access_legend.api-sample: Real public source. direct_url is a small live query to the official API (fetched from the source, not mirrored here).
access_legend.bulk-file: Real public source. direct_url is the official bulk download file from the source.
access_legend.official-site: Real public source. direct_url is the official download or API page; read its terms first.
access_legend.link-only: LINK ONLY: never copy this data into repositories, decks or shared files. Use it at the source under its own terms.

everything_at_once.description: Every synthetic file in one ZIP (all packs, CRM tables, SQLite, READMEs)
Every synthetic CSV row and document in one JSON Lines file, tagged with pack and file
One combined CSV per table type across the three packs, with pack and product columns
Connected practice CRM only (CSV tables + SQLite)
Manifest (JSON + CSV), public catalog, synthetic index and real evidence snapshots

datasets.name: PubMed / NCBI E-utilities
datasets.license: NLM data; abstracts may carry publisher copyright
datasets.description: 35M+ biomedical citations and abstracts with MeSH indexing; search, summary, fetch, link endpoints.

datasets.name: PMC Open Access Subset
datasets.license: Varies per article (check each article's license statement)
datasets.description: Full-text articles and preprints under Creative Commons or similar reuse licenses.

datasets.name: Europe PMC REST API
datasets.license: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use; article licenses vary (CC-BY/CC-BY-NC/CC0 or open access per Open Targets licence table)
datasets.description: Literature incl. PubMed, PMC, preprints (bioRxiv/medRxiv), patents, grants; open-access filtering.

datasets.name: Crossref REST API
datasets.license: 'Almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright… use it for any purpose'; some abstracts may be copyrighted
datasets.description: DOI metadata from publishers: funding, licenses, ORCID/ROR IDs, post-publication updates (retractions/corrections), some abstracts.

datasets.name: OpenAlex
datasets.license: Data free; full dataset openly downloadable (per pricing page)
datasets.description: Open index of works, authors, institutions, topics and citations; full dataset downloadable.

datasets.name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
datasets.description: 214M papers, 2.49B citations, 79M authors; recommendations; downloadable datasets.

datasets.name: bioRxiv / medRxiv API
datasets.description: Preprint metadata (title, authors, abstract, license, category, JATS XML path, published DOI), publication linkage, usage stats.

datasets.name: NIH RePORTER API
datasets.license: US government data (license not stated in excerpt)
datasets.description: NIH-funded projects and publications: PIs, institutions, abstracts, funding amounts.

datasets.name: ORCID Public API
datasets.description: Researcher identifiers with public works, affiliations and funding.

datasets.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
datasets.license: Terms page is JS-rendered and could not be read (UNVERIFIED)
datasets.description: 400k+ registered studies: design, arms, eligibility, outcomes, sites, sponsors, results.

datasets.name: WHO ICTRP Search Portal
datasets.license: WHO ICTRP Terms and Conditions accepted on download
datasets.description: Trials from WHO primary registries worldwide (ChiCTR, EU, ISRCTN, CTRI, etc.).

datasets.name: EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) public portal
datasets.license: Public under CTR, with exemptions (e.g., personal data)
datasets.description: EU/EEA trials under the Clinical Trials Regulation (from 31 Jan 2023); older trials in the EU Clinical Trials Register.

datasets.name: ISRCTN registry
datasets.description: UK-centric registry of trials and other studies.

datasets.name: openFDA (labels, FAERS, recalls, Drugs@FDA, NDC, shortages)
datasets.license: CC0 1.0 unless noted (GMDN device terms excluded; no AI training on GMDN content without license)
datasets.description: drug/label (SPL sections), drug/event (FAERS), drug/enforcement (recalls), drug/drugsfda (approval history), drug/ndc, drug/shortages.

datasets.name: DailyMed web services (NLM)
datasets.license: NLM/FDA label content (license not stated in excerpt)
datasets.description: Current and archived SPL labels (Rx, OTC), set IDs, version history, PDFs/ZIPs; full bulk label downloads (daily/weekly/monthly).

datasets.name: Drugs@FDA data files
datasets.description: 12 tables: applications, products, submissions, marketing status, approval documents.

datasets.name: FDA Orange Book data files
datasets.description: Approved small-molecule products, therapeutic equivalence, patents and exclusivity (3 ASCII files).

datasets.name: FDA Purple Book (licensed biologics)
datasets.description: Licensed biological products, biosimilarity/interchangeability, exclusivity; patent list.

datasets.name: FDA Novel Drug Approvals 2026 (CDER)
datasets.description: List of 2026 novel approvals with indications.

datasets.name: FDA Drug Trials Snapshots
datasets.description: Per-approval demographics of pivotal-trial participants; annual summary reports (2025 PDF).

datasets.name: FDA guidance documents search
datasets.description: All FDA guidance with topic filters incl. RWD/RWE.

datasets.name: EMA website data in JSON (medicines, EPAR documents, PSUSAs, DHPCs, orphans, PIPs, shortages, guidelines)
datasets.description: Centrally authorised medicines (2,746 records on test), EPAR documents, post-authorisation procedures, referrals, PSUSAs, DHPCs, orphan designations, PIPs, shortages, scientific guidelines; updated overnight.

datasets.name: MedlinePlus Connect
datasets.description: Patient-friendly health topic and drug information keyed by ICD-10-CM, RxCUI, NDC, LOINC.

datasets.name: WHO VigiAccess (VigiBase public view)
datasets.license: UMC disclaimer; no individual case reports
datasets.description: Counts of reported suspected ADRs by active ingredient, grouped by continent, age, sex.

datasets.name: NICE guidance & technology appraisals (syndication API)
datasets.license: UK use free (NICE UK Open Content Licence); international test licence £550, worldwide service licence £60,000/yr
datasets.description: UK clinical guidelines and technology appraisals.

datasets.name: CMS Medicare Coverage Database (Coverage API + downloads)
datasets.license: Some endpoints need a 1-hour token after accepting AMA CPT / ADA / AHA license agreements
datasets.description: National Coverage Determinations, Local Coverage Determinations, articles; full ZIP downloads.

datasets.name: ICER assessments
datasets.description: US cost-effectiveness and value assessments by condition.

datasets.name: Guidelines International Network library
datasets.description: Library of guidelines and links to national guideline repositories (AWMF, BIGG, USPSTF, etc.).

datasets.name: Medicare Part D Spending by Drug (annual + quarterly)
datasets.description: Spending, claims, beneficiaries, unit cost by brand/generic and manufacturer.

datasets.name: NPPES NPI Registry API
datasets.description: Every US provider NPI: name, taxonomy/specialty, practice addresses, identifiers.

datasets.name: CMS Open Payments
datasets.description: Industry payments to physicians, NPPs, teaching hospitals (general, research, ownership); 2019–2025 shown; PY2025 published, next update Jan 2027.

datasets.name: Medicare Part D Prescribers by Provider and Drug
datasets.description: Claims, 30-day fills, days supply, drug cost by prescriber NPI, brand and generic; annual, latest 2024.

datasets.name: WHO Global Health Observatory OData API
datasets.license: WHO datasets terms: royalty-free use with attribution; no sale of data
datasets.description: Thousands of country-level indicators (e.g., obesity prevalence NCD_BMI_30A).

datasets.name: CDC Open Data portal (data.cdc.gov, Socrata SODA API)
datasets.description: Hundreds of CDC datasets (surveillance, chronic disease, vaccination).

datasets.name: CDC WONDER
datasets.license: CDC data use restrictions; cite 'powered by CDC WONDER'
datasets.description: Mortality, natality, cancer statistics, VAERS and more as aggregated queries.

datasets.name: NHANES
datasets.description: US survey: demographics, exam, lab, questionnaire, dietary data.

datasets.name: SEER (NCI) — Explorer, research data, SEER API
IHME Global Burden of Disease (GBD Results)
datasets.license: Free-of-charge NON-COMMERCIAL user agreement; no redistribution of data sets (links allowed)
datasets.description: GBD 2023 estimates 1990–2023: incidence, prevalence, DALYs, deaths by cause/country.

datasets.name: AHRQ Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS)
datasets.description: US healthcare use and spending survey files.

datasets.name: HMA-EMA Catalogues of RWD sources and studies (ex-EU PAS Register)
datasets.description: Registered RWD sources and non-interventional/PAS studies in Europe; exportable.

datasets.name: RxNav APIs (RxNorm, RxClass, RxTerms)
datasets.license: No license needed for RxNorm API (one exception); SNOMED-derived RxClass content under SNOMED Affiliate license
datasets.description: Normalized drug names/RxCUIs, brand↔generic, NDC links; RxClass drug classes (ATC, EPC, MoA).

datasets.name: MeSH RDF / Lookup API
datasets.license: NLM terms: no charges/usage fees for MeSH
datasets.description: Medical Subject Headings: descriptors, qualifiers, trees, pharmacological actions; SPARQL; full RDF download.

datasets.name: NLM Clinical Table Search Service (ICD-10-CM and more)
datasets.description: Autocomplete/search APIs for ICD-10-CM codes (also other tables).

datasets.name: WHO ICD-11 API
datasets.description: ICD-11 (and ICD-10) classification via REST; Embedded Classification Tool; local container.

datasets.name: UMLS Metathesaurus (incl. SNOMED CT US, MedDRA via license)
datasets.license: UMLS license; some sources need extra vendor agreements
datasets.description: Crosswalk of 200+ vocabularies; SNOMED CT US Edition distributed to UMLS licensees.

datasets.name: Open Targets Platform (GraphQL + official MCP)
datasets.license: Data CC0 1.0; code Apache-2.0; underlying sources vary

datasets.name: ChEMBL web services
datasets.description: Bioactive molecules, mechanisms, max phase, ATC.

datasets.name: FDA Patient-Focused Drug Development meeting reports (FDA-led and externally-led)
datasets.license: US government (externally-led reports authored by patient groups)
datasets.description: 'Voice of the Patient' reports on symptoms, impacts and treatment preferences by condition.

datasets.name: Reddit Data API (patient communities)
datasets.license: Data API Terms: commercial use needs a separate agreement; no ML/AI training on user content without rightsholder permission

datasets.name: Community MCP servers bundling public APIs (pharma-mcp, @drvibeai/clinical-apis-mcp, PubCrawl, helix-mcp)
datasets.description: Wrap ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, openFDA/FAERS, and (clinical-apis-mcp) Europe PMC, RxNorm, ICD-10, MedlinePlus, NPI, OpenAlex, PubChem, DailyMed, ChEMBL, Open Targets.
